title: What the Nightly Rate Includes at Table: Board across the Hotel Rate Plans
content:
Board is the part of the Hotel Rate Plans schedule that says what a guest eats without paying again at the property.

| Rate plan | Breakfast included | Breakfast, per person per day, USD | Dinner included | Meals, soft drinks and listed activities all included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 28.0 | no | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no | 26.0 | no | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 24.0 | no | no |
| Standard Flexible Rate | yes | 0.0 | no | no |
| Member Flex Rate | yes | 0.0 | no | no |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes | 0.0 | no | no |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0.0 | yes | yes |

Where breakfast is included the plan records a breakfast amount of 0.0 USD, there being nothing to charge. Where it is not, the amount is charged per person per day: 28.0 USD on the Non-Refundable Saver Rate, 26.0 USD on the Advance Purchase 21 Rate and 24.0 USD on the Semi-Flexible Rate.

Only the All-Inclusive Flex Rate records dinner as included, and it is the only plan on which meals, soft drinks and the listed activities are all included in the nightly rate. Breakfast alone is included on the Standard Flexible Rate, the Member Flex Rate and the Suite Flexible Rate.

*A worked reading.* Two guests over 3 days on the Advance Purchase 21 Rate, at the 26.0 USD per person per day this schedule records, come to 156.00 USD of breakfast.
